parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: campaign_id
parameters.description: The GMS Campaign ID. Provide if available.

parameters.name: edit_action
parameters.description: The following is the list of possible actions and their required fields: 1.change_budgetdaily_budget 2.change_durationstart_date 3.end_date 4.pause 5.resume 6.start 7.change_roas_targetroas_target: when edit_action = change_roas_target, you must provide: roas_target (float) Value rules follow the same logic as in the create endpoint

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End date of Campaign e.g. "11-11-2025". Do not fill if no end date.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: reference_id
parameters.description: Generated by developers, used to prevent duplicate requests Submitting the same reference_id more than once will fail; a new reference_id must be generated to retry. Example: 086a16bf-49e9-4103-b7fe-c0125beb9278

parameters.name: roas_target
parameters.description: No input will be GMV Max Auto Bidding (Shop). Input 0 for GMV Max Auto Bidding (Shop). Input greater than 0 for GMV Max Custom ROAS (Shop). If value = 10.123456, it will be taken as 10.1 If value = 10.199999, it will be taken as 10.1

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start date of Campaign e.g. "11-11-2025". Cannot be earlier than today.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

$curl = curl_init();

  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/ads/edit_gms_product_campaign?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',

    "campaign_id": 12412421,

    "edit_action": "change_budget",

}',

    'Content-Type: application/json'

));

echo $response;

import requests
import json

url = "https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/ads/edit_gms_product_campaign?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp"

payload=json.dumps({
  "campaign_id": 12412421,
  "daily_budget": 100.12,
  "edit_action": "change_budget",
  "end_date": "11-11-2025",
  "start_date": "11-11-2025"
})
headers = {
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
}
response = requests.RPCRequest("POST",url,headers=headers, data=payload, allow_redirects=False)

print(response.text)
